column11: Fish stocks relative to the maximum sustainable yield
column12: Fish stocks are measured by their biomass: the number of individuals multiplied by their mass.\nHere it's measured as the biomass of a fish stock divided by the biomass at its maximum sustainable yield – the level at which we can catch the maximum amount of fish without a decline in fish populations. A value of one maximises fish catch without decreasing fish populations.
